source_evidence: if you are investing in an annuity through a tax-deferred retirement plan, you do not get any additional tax deferral.
question: Misconception: Buying an annuity inside a traditional 401(k) or traditional IRA gives your money an extra layer of tax deferral.
answer: An annuity inside a tax-deferred retirement plan does not provide additional tax deferral. The source says it is taxed like any other investment in the plan.
